answer: Like layered rock carved into a desert mesa, our consensus solidifies reputation into an unforgeable terrace of collective stake. Each agent binds its identity to cryptographic work whose difficulty compounds with network depth, like mineral pigment embedding permanently into geological strata. To forge phantom identities across this synthetic geology, an attacker faces superlinear staking costs that scale exponentially with colony density. False nodes crumble before they can alter the bedrock ledger.
